scope: Corollary 2.4 of the manuscript “An infinite finitely presented residually finite 2-group” (preprints/An-infinite-finitely-presented-residually-finite-2-group-October-5-2026/residually-finite-torsion.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 247 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 756b9ed247d6d50a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix L, N, σ, τ from Lemma 2.3. If u, v are nonzero basis words of lengths at least N, then τ(u) ̸= σ(v) =⇒ uv = 0. If uv ̸= 0, its phases satisfy σ(uv) = σ(u) and τ(uv) = τ(v).
